shipped_rows.title_o: A Self-Report Scale to Help Make Psychiatric Diagnoses

blind_target.evidence_quote: The present report is the second large-scale validation study of the PDSQ in psychiatric out-patients. Because some of the sizes of the diagnostic groups in the initial report were modest, it is important to determine whether the recommended cut-off scores to screen for psychiatric disorders remained the same in a replication study.
blind_target.outcome_quote: Based on receiver operating curve analysis, the PDSQ performed as well in the replication sample as in the initial validation study.
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: The abstract explicitly compares overall diagnostic performance with the initial validation and says it performed as well. A count of unchanged cutoff scores does not by itself overturn that overall comparison. The abstract gives no citation identifying the initial validation paper; bibliographic fields are left empty.

luna_triage.reason: The abstract establishes a retest of the initial PDSQ validation, but does not identify its authors, title, or citation. The supplied row 658 is Zimmerman and Mattia (2001), titled as the self-report scale paper, but the abstract does not establish that this is the same initial validation work rather than a related scale-development report. Need the full paper's citation/reference for the initial validation and confirmation that row 658 represents it.
